about.en: MNSRY is the official token of Mansory, the German luxury-car customisation house founded by Kourosh Mansory in 1989. Holders can stake it into tiers that unlock discounts, raffles, VIP events and NFT-based authenticity certificates for Mansory cars. It launched on Solana with mint 1xdtu7y3LkkrVCAbm5KGKfYzq1qgKhxxk5AaJBqpump and the project also issues it on BNB Chain at 0x0fcfe33b46e5b21e5e96b722d4c85510198f9255.
